missionPremise: WDLL item 3 (P-49 PE): inspect cites rrc-pipeline-fact from cortex-root pipelineFact. Cortex already serving (item 2 met). Gold 48021:34137 is present-outside (state=present nearPipeline=false t4permit null). Nearby 48021:10048 is present-near (t4permit=05781 ENERGY TRANSFER COMPANY 87.9 m). Pipelines are a spatial overlay at WRITE time. Do not copy the special-district :sd: picker. texas-rrc stays live:false unless inspect is wired AND overlay fetch is the atom. This card implements against fixtures. No deploy. Sources: _dispatches/2026-08-22_serve-pe-p49_dispatch.md; _inbox/2026-08-22_p49_cortex_execute.json; hauska-map PR 177 at 0f658a2.
completionPredicate: mergeBakedBaseFacts copies a fixture pipelineFact from the cortex JSON ROOT onto the atom-chain payload and does not copy bake / CAD / texas-rrc GIS onto that field. A missing field stays missing. Early return with no facets still attaches the root field. Inspect Pipeline row reads pipelineFact only. Gold-shaped present-outside fixture does not render ENERGY TRANSFER / Prairie Lea / a permit. Present-near fixture 48021:10048 shows t4permit=05781. Typed absent/refused stays visible. fetchCortexFacetsWithAlias retries when pipelineFact is missing even if flood / land-use / special-district are already present. Integer parcel is the live probe; padded 404 is a bake miss not a pipeline miss. texas-rrc stays live:false unless overlay fetch is proved as rrc-pipeline-fact. Diff uncommitted. No deploy.
scopeBasis: PE BFF copy plus inspect Pipeline row / resolver. Cortex owns the atom read (already serving). Live inspect is atom-chain-warm so mergeBakedBaseFacts is the live path. Do not adopt bake / CAD / texas-rrc GIS as pipelineFact. Do not invent ENERGY TRANSFER on gold 48021:34137. Do not add a :sd: or :pipeline: picker. Do not start P-50. Do not flip texas-rrc or mud-pid. Do not occupy P:/hauska-map or the property seat checkout. ParcelFactSheet stays frozen on required fields; pipeline is additive optional so stubs do not break.

fieldContract.typeGuard: plain object whose state is present | absent | refused. Reject null, strings, arrays, and bake / GIS objects parked on the root with no state.

fieldContract.dualGrammar: integer parcel is the live probe. Padded 48021:34137.00000000 is a cortex bake 404 today. Alias retries missing pipelineFact. Do not treat padded 404 as a pipeline miss.
never: bake / CAD / texas-rrc GIS as pipelineFact
ENERGY TRANSFER / Prairie Lea / a permit on gold present-outside
flip texas-rrc without proving overlay fetch is rrc-pipeline-fact

design.livePath: PROPERTY_ATOM_PATH=1 → fetchAtomChainWithAlias + fetchCortexFacetsWithAlias + mergeBakedBaseFacts(adapted, cortexBody) + echoRequestedParcelNodeId. Cortex-off strip already spreads the root.

alias.rule: fetchCortexFacetsWithAlias retries when floodHazardFact OR landUseFact OR specialDistrictFact OR pipelineFact is missing on a 2xx (or on 404). Return alias only when it fills a root-fact gap.

resolver.whenPresentNear: sheet.pipeline from operatorName / t4permit / nearestPipelineDistanceMeters; provenance.source = rrc-pipeline-fact
resolver.whenPresentOutside: sheet.pipeline present with outside-buffer wording only; never operator / permit / system / commodity
resolver.whenRefused: unresolved with named code; row stays visible
resolver.whenFieldMissing: optional field omitted; card facet unknown so FactRow hides it

adversarialReview.objection: Rename a texas-rrc GIS paint or CAD bake field to pipelineFact and call that the atom.
adversarialReview.response: Dispatch forbids adopting bake / CAD / texas-rrc GIS as that field. Cortex already writes a ROOT sibling from rrc-pipeline-fact atoms. Copying GIS would look like a merge win while remaining starved of the atom.
adversarialReview.disposition: ROOT only. Type guard requires state present|absent|refused.

adversarialReview.objection: Paint ENERGY TRANSFER / Prairie Lea on gold 48021:34137 because nearby 48021:10048 has that body.
adversarialReview.response: Gold live bind is present-outside (nearPipeline=false t4permit null). Present-near payload is 48021:10048. Painting ENERGY TRANSFER on gold is the defect the dispatch names.
adversarialReview.disposition: Fail closed. Gold present-outside must not render operator / permit / system.

adversarialReview.objection: Flip texas-rrc live:true because inspect is about to be wired.

adversarialReview.disposition: Leave live:false. Say so in the close.

adversarialReview.objection: Copy the special-district :sd: picker so PE can bind pipeline by entity_id suffix.
adversarialReview.response: Pipelines are a spatial overlay at WRITE time. Dual grammar is parcel prefix only. Cortex already bound the atom. PE copies the interpreted field.
